POP Series 7

Released March 1, 2008 · 17 cards

POP Series 7 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the POP series, released in English on March 1, 2008. It has 17 cards. It includes 17 Pokémon, 0 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.
